subtitle: Scan, split, and pay — no more IOUs
description:
FoodSplitter makes splitting restaurant bills dead simple. No more awkward math, no more Venmo requests weeks later, no more "I'll get you next time."

HOW IT WORKS:
1. One person pays the bill at the restaurant
2. Open FoodSplitter and snap a photo of the receipt
3. Our scanner automatically reads every item
4. Tap each item to assign who ordered it
5. Tax and tip are split proportionally — fair and accurate
6. Everyone gets a notification and pays their share instantly

FAIR SPLITTING:
• Each person pays for exactly what they ordered
• Shared items (appetizers, pitchers) are split among those who shared
• Tax is proportional to your food total — not a flat split
• Tip is proportional too — no one overpays

INSTANT PAYMENTS:
• Link your bank account or card once
• Pay your share with one tap
• Money goes directly to whoever paid the bill
• Everyone sees real-time payment status

SMART FEATURES:
• Receipt scanner with OCR — no manual entry needed
• Real-time updates — everyone sees the split live
• Push notifications for payment requests
• Full history of past meals and payments
• Works with any group size

PERFECT FOR:
• Friend groups who eat out together
• Roommates splitting groceries
• Work lunches and team dinners
• Date nights where you split the check
• Large group dinners and celebrations

Payments are processed securely through Stripe. We never store your card details.
